responsibility: Provides the specialized rustc driver used while building a sysroot for Cranelift, coordinating when to invoke the default LLVM backend versus the Cranelift backend. It parses the `--clif` switch, keeps host-side compilations on the normal sysroot and backend by default, switches target-side compilations to Cranelift with Cranelift-specific panic and sysroot settings when requested, and then runs the compiler with the selected backend behavior.
